text:
maria: Quick sync from today's micro-sweep — observed a consistent pattern: L4/T4/A10 show KV-cache thrash and p99 blips on KV-heavy short-batch traffic (seq ~1024, batch 1-4). A100/H100 stay stable. Posting numbers + proposed autotune presets for review.
aj: Which model/weight config did you run? tiny/med/24B?
maria: 24B-ish (gpt-style, 32k kv entries), fp16 runtime. Tests: batches 1,2,4,8; seq 512/1024/2048. Problem most visible at seq=1024 batch<=4.
chen: Pasted a minimal profiling capture — stack shows repeated KV miss evictions on L4: lots of memcpy + small GEMM kernels. On H100 path we get large fused GEMM which avoids the mem copies.
chen: ```
# kernel mapping extracted from trace
L4: small_tile_gemm -> qkv_split -> memcpy -> kv_store
A100/H100: fused_gemm_qkv -> direct_kv_update
```
ryan: Perf numbers from the sweep (median ms/token):
A100 batch1 seq1024: 3.4 ms/token
H100 batch1 seq1024: 2.9 ms/token
L4 batch1 seq1024: 7.9 ms/token
L4 w/kv-warmup (patch): 4.2 ms/token
L4 batch4 seq1024: 5.6 ms/token (less bad)
aj: kv-warmup patch = prefetching first N KV pages? curious about memory overhead.
maria: Yes, kv-warmup prefetches prefix KV slots and pins them for first requests; tradeoff is ~200MB extra pinned memory on L4 16GB. For A10/T4 it's similar but proportionally larger on 16GB devices.
chen: Proposed autotune preset (draft):
```json
{
  "device_family": "l4",
  "seq_len_thresholds": [128,512,1024],
  "kernel_policy": {
    "short": "smol_gemm",
    "mid": "hybrid_prefetch",
    "long": "fused_prefetch"
  },
  "kv_warmup": {"enabled": true, "prefix_pages": 4, "eviction_guard": 0.2},
  "batching": {"max_batch": 8, "prefer_latency": true}
}
```
sasha: Suggest we keep kv_warmup off by default for free-tier and enable in Dedicated profiles. Also add a telemetry tag so we can measure memory regression.
ryan: Also saw that when seq distribution skews low (most requests <128) L4 picks smol_gemm and we get fastest perf. So the autotuner must be seqlen-aware with warmstart from observed distribution.
aj: Any regressions vs current presets? did you compare rollout A/B?
maria: Current default preset (non-autotune) on L4 is causing the p99 spikes we saw. With autotune + kv_warmup the p99 improved ~30% in canary. Median also improved but not as dramatic.
sasha: Rollout plan: canary 5% on L4 pools in us-west, enable telemetry.tag=kv_warmup.v1, keep fallback to legacy kernel on error. If stable for 48h -> 25% -> 100%.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/eng-runtime/l4-kvwarmup-v1 -> 2024-11-03T15:22Z by maria
maria: Thanks — action items: (1) chen push preset PR with telemetry flag, (2) ryans' microbench harness to generate longer-run p99 graphs, (3) sasha draft rollout/remove plan. I'll watch canary telemetry and report back.
aj: ack

maria: Great — if canary looks good we'll include the preset as 'l4-kv-warmup-v1' in the next release notes.
